titles.title: Abstraction Dark Green Lines with Red and Pink

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Two dark green patches of paint run vertically down the paper.  A red circle is located in between the two patches.  The area above the red circle is painted in a soft pink hue, while the area below the circle is yellowish in color.
